record.category: Decentralized storage subnet — erasure-coded, iroh transport

free_tier.stated: Paid storage product (Hippius sells S3-compatible storage, Drive, Hub). No free tier published on the pages opened.

egress.terms: 'Competitive pricing, no surprises—just pay for what you use'. Metered, no free allowance stated.

record.interface_detail: HTTP gateway (:3000) for upload/download; S3-compatible product separately; miner/validator P2P via iroh `FetchBlob`.
record.tooling: Reed-Solomon k=10/m=20 over 2 MiB stripes, CRUSH placement, PoSt audits via Plonky3, on-chain miner registration.
record.chaining: Interesting architecture reference rather than a usable free store: it is the only system seen that combines erasure coding with iroh, i.e. 20 TiB of user data would occupy 60 TiB of miner disk at 3x parity.
record.limits_note: Repo marked 'Active Development ... subject to change without notice', with a disclaimer beside that marker. Miner registration is on-chain.
record.reliability_note: Testnet-stage code; the validator is a metadata authority and a single point of coordination for placement and recovery.

evidence.proved: README: architecture, RS(10,20), CRUSH, iroh FetchBlob, active development warning
commercial decentralized storage: Arion, S3-compatible, Drive, Hub; 'pay for what you use, recorded on-chain'
